summary: Volunteer recruiting page: Fall Ball 2026 tally, four roles (coach, umpire, team and fields, board with the open Umpire in Chief seat), employer hour matching, the three cleared-volunteer steps, then the sign-up listing.
blurb: Ways to help this season, from coaching to umpiring to fields, and how to get cleared to volunteer.

sources.fact: Spring volunteer roles BLS asks for: head and assistant coaches, adult and junior umpires, team volunteers, general volunteers.

Team volunteer examples: help on the field at a game or practice, be a dugout parent, keep score. Register and get cleared early even if not 100% sure. BLS sends volunteer info to JDP; the volunteer must answer JDP's email before the check starts. Background check questions: secretary@blslittleleague.org.
Abuse Awareness training is required every year on top of the background check. No certificate to send; use the same email you registered to volunteer with.
Volunteers cleared in the spring keep a valid background check and Abuse Awareness training for Fall Ball.
The Fields Committee is recruiting members for the upcoming season.
Committee roles take less time than board seats; the Fields Committee helps maintain and improve fields.
All board positions are voted on at the October General Membership Meeting; Umpire in Chief was an open seat.
The Jr. Umpire program was reinstated in 2025.
Employers including Microsoft, Starbucks, Boeing and MultiCare offer volunteer-hour matching; BLS has a Corporate Matching page.

Nov 1 board meeting (draft minutes, for approval Dec 6): the board created the Fields Committee; it will organize and recruit volunteers to help clean up, clear weeds, set pegs and prepare fields and job boxes.
